attempts.summary: Deployed an inventory application on node1 (Ubuntu 24.04) served on TCP port 8181 by a Python HTTP server under systemd, confined by a dedicated AppArmor profile loaded in enforce mode, while system-wide AppArmor (Ubuntu's mandatory access control) remained active/enforcing throughout. Verified the app serves inventory JSON with HTTP 200 both before and after a full node restart, and confirmed the restart via a changed kernel boot_id.
